verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is a community report that Shortwave imported a user's existing Gmail aliases and signatures. That reflects Gmail send-as aliases, a host-platform capability, not a Shortwave feature for creating aliases or masked addresses to shield the user's real address. No first-party evidence shows Shortwave offers alias generation or masked or hide-my-email addresses.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can use aliases or masked addresses so sign-ups and strangers never learn my real address
